$comment: Provider pack: docling layout-aware document extraction (complex tables, multi-column, scanned PDFs where markitdown returns garbage). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack docling. NOTE: docling-mcp[local] must be installed first (setup.sh does this via install_docling; ~3-4 GB with models from huggingface.co on first convert). Uses permission.tool (matching opencode.json's actual key structure) so the deep-merge correctly flips deny→true.
